meta.source: weekly harvest scan 2026-11-23 -- three parallel sweeps: (a) arXiv math.CO/math.NT (search-driven; arXiv API timed out twice, no full listing enumeration; Nov 23 math.CO listing 56 entries, titles not shown); (b) arXiv math.PR/math.NA/cs.DM/cs.SC (cs.DM 11 primary + cs.SC 5 fully abs-page-checked; math.PR/math.NA keyword-screened, Nov 17 remainders and Nov 16 mail not title-enumerated; cross-scope Lean claims in cs.DS/math.AP routed in by sweep B, verified live); (c) math blogs, public GitHub repos, HexagonMath deposits and Zenodo records (Tao Nov 20 post covered; Gowers latest Oct 16; Hexagon discovery via Post-Cutoff Nov 21 listing, 89 deposits 2611.00697-00789, subset individually opened; Zenodo record pages returned 403, listing-level only). Top code links spot-verified live by the parent: GRH mirror repo (public, created 2026-11-20, commit 7cbf7a0c, lean-toolchain present, 175,187 files), Euler arXiv:2611.26772 abs page (submitted Nov 19, ancillary terminal_smoothness files), Navier-Stokes repo (public, created 2026-11-20, commit ad53419, certificate NOT in repo per README), Turan five-cycle Hexagon page (2611.00770v1, Nov 21, Zenodo 23743819, toolchain v4.32.2, 692 native_decide facts), Zarankiewicz Hexagon page (2611.00319v1, Nov 16, archive release v1 commit 10385847). Registered candidate toric-code-lean-device-model: trigger checked (arXiv:2611.03329 still v1 only, no ancillary files, no repo link) -- not fired, stays WAITING, silent in delivery. Coverage caveats: math.NT keyword-searched only, not fully enumerated; Nov 21-22 weekend submissions and Nov 23 mail may be incompletely indexed; Hexagon Nov 19-23 deposits beyond those found may exist (Kruer-group 35-deposit cascade of Lean-checked Erdos-problem results 2611.00746-00787, 2611.00760, 2611.00739, 2611.00702/00703/00704, 2611.00730, 2611.00788, 2611.00789, 2611.00699, 2611.00700/00701, 2611.00557, 2611.00580 not individually assessed); Nov 22-23 deposits unswept (search-index lag); gitlab.com policy-blocked, Girsanov Lean repo still unresolvable. Near-misses failing public inputs: 2611.05514 (re-checked, still no code), 2611.16043 (Girsanov-Wasserstein, GitLab ref unresolvable), 2611.19610 (elite primes, Lean claimed, no repo/ancillary), 2611.20146 (evacuation Farkas certificates, no files), 2611.23622 (2x2 matmul, no code), 2611.18148 (pulsed-field ablation, no code link), 2611.01257 (DFT bound, Lean claimed, no code location), Hexagon 2611.00729v1 (peaceable queens a(19)=52, a(20)=58, repo URL unlocated), Hexagon 2611.00644v1 (AKLT gap, Lean source explicitly not included), Hexagon 2611.00721v1 / 2611.00716v1 (pure theory), Hexagon 2611.00769v1 (Euler dense blow-up data, no code/Lean), Masullo GRH manuscript (no public code/data), Anthropic Fable 5.2 FLT re-proof (Lean code still unreleased), 2611.26272 (Paper2Lean tool paper, not a single claim), 2611.17618 (Lean-PEP tool paper). Cut by the 10-cap: chromatic-cochromatic-gap-random-graph (Hexagon 2611.00562v1, Lean/Palomar covers only weaker 0.032 constant), biased-random-walk-gw-speed-monotonicity (Hexagon 2611.00735v1, full-interval decrease only sketched), romanoff-upper-density-04893562 (Hexagon 2611.00570v1), pte-2adic-n13-n15 (Hexagon 2611.00571v1), mub-c6-no-fourier-vanishing (arXiv:2611.19809, bound not new), collatz-syracuse-holomorphic (arXiv:2611.11641, single .lean file, no repo/pin). Out-of-window flags: Hexagon 2611.00333 (exact LRX diameter of S_n, Lean repo + Palomar PALOMAR-2026-11-10-000010, published Nov 11-12, missed by the 2026-11-16 run), Hexagon 2611.00349 (Caceres Lambda <= 0.174, Nov 13, weaker than audited 0.1486), 2611.10961 (Grothendieck/Korenblum constants, Nov 7, code location unverified), hubbard-spectral-moments-lean (arXiv:2611.19929, cond-mat, repo stated in paper but not live-verified this run).
